description: Land Acquisition - Nagoda, Kalutara D/S Division, Kalutara District - Amendment to the notice published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1030/22 of 04.06.1998
reasoning: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains specific notices for acquiring land for public purposes, including detailed descriptions of land parcels, their locations, extents, and claimant information.
